Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Glucono delta-lactone is used as a sequestrant in food. Its technological role is to bind metal ions.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include unripened cheese excluding products falling in category 16, ripened cheese, whey cheese, cheese products (excluding products falling in category 16). These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
